notes: PROVISIONAL: drafted from public secondary sources (Annex A control IDs/titles agreed by riskprofs.com and tcsa.in; main-clause titles per docs.modulos.ai), not from the purchased standard. The compliance lead must confirm every row against ISO/IEC 42001:2023 and stamp it (stampedBy/stampedAt) before the mapping page is built or cited (AOC-SPEC-003 §13, risk R3). Scope assumption to confirm (clause 4.3): the AIMS covers the organisation's use of AI coding agents (Claude Code) through AOC to develop, change and promote software; agent sessions plus AOC are treated as the AI system in operation for A.6.2.x rows. Rows carrying a correctionNote that starts 'Corrected per §13' implement the five known AOC-SPEC-002 corrections. Evidence entries are descriptive names of AOC event types (Wave 0 event catalog in packages/contracts/src/events) and artifacts. See docs/compliance/iso42001-annex-a.md. Each row's eventTypes lists the catalog event types it counts in evidence packs (prefix.* expands to the whole family); it must name exactly the types its evidence entries cite.

rows.aocControl: Append-only, hash-chained audit event log with a single writer (aocd)
rows.aocFeature: kernel EventStore: hash chain over ids/enums/hashes in clear, bodies in a per-session encrypted store with only their hash chained; liveness state changes chained, raw heartbeats not
rows.clauseTitle: AI system recording of event logs
evidence: hash-chained event log (seq, prevHash, hash per event)
body.erased events (crypto-shred leaves the chain valid)
rows.correctionNote: Corrected per §13: AOC-SPEC-002 mapped event logging to A.6.2.6, which is operation and monitoring. Event logging is A.6.2.8.

rows.aocControl: Off-host anchoring of the nightly chain head; Verify tests the chain against the external anchor
rows.aocFeature: mod-audit nightly anchor job (signed commit to a separate repository or RFC 3161 timestamp) and Verify
rows.clauseTitle: AI system recording of event logs
evidence: anchor.created events (anchor receipt: commit SHA or RFC 3161 token hash)
chain.verified events tested against every external anchor
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. Supports the integrity of the A.6.2.8 record (risk R2: an in-file hash chain alone is defeatable). Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Frozen, ISO-mapped audit evidence pack
rows.aocFeature: mod-evidence one-button pack: date-ranged, hash-verified, control-mapped bundle with rate-card and mapping versions embedded and a compliance-lead stamp (provisional until stamped)
evidence: evidence pack artifact (manifest with per-event hashes)
rows.correctionNote: Corrected per §13: AOC-SPEC-002 mapped technical documentation to change management. Technical documentation is A.6.2.7; change management is anchored to clauses 6.3 and 8.1 (map-008, map-009).

rows.aocControl: Control of documented information (evidence integrity and retention)
rows.aocFeature: hash-chained log, off-host anchor, frozen evidence packs, crypto-shredding for erasure, off-host backup with defined key custody (R6)
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. Main-clause anchor added because the evidence pack is the organisation's documented information for audits. Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Three-role access model (Approver, Builder, Requester) on a per-person identity layer
rows.aocFeature: mod-identity: users and roles, bearer tokens (attribution in v1), per-decision passkeys (WebAuthn) for go-live, rollback and break-glass; escalations never route back to the requester (separation of duties)
evidence: decision.resolved events carrying the resolving person and role
rows.correctionNote: Corrected per §13: AOC-SPEC-002 mapped roles to A.5. A.5 is impact assessment; AI roles and responsibilities is A.3.2.

rows.aocControl: Change request impact analysis, mandatory before work starts
rows.aocFeature: mod-change: a change request cannot start until impact analysis, mitigation plan, rollback plan (exact tag or SHA) and acceptance test are supplied and approved; AI drafts the fields, the developer must edit or affirm each
evidence: change.submitted events (all four fields present, field hashes chained)
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. Impact analysis is anchored to A.5 and main clause 6.1.4 (map-008). Confirm whether a per-change impact analysis satisfies the A.5.2 process or only feeds it; A.5.4 and A.5.5 (impacts on individuals and society) are not covered by AOC.

rows.aocControl: Retention of change impact analyses
rows.aocFeature: impact analysis text kept in the encrypted body store with its hash in the chain; included in evidence packs
rows.clauseTitle: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
evidence: change.submitted payload (impact analysis) and its chained hash
evidence pack section listing change records with impact analyses
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. Crypto-shredding a body (body.erased) removes the text but keeps the hash, so retention periods must be agreed with the compliance lead. Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Change request impact analysis (main-clause anchor)
rows.aocFeature: as map-006
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. Main-clause anchor for impact analysis (A.5 / 6.1.4). Clause 8.4 (impact assessment during operation) may also apply. Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Planned changes to the AI management system and AOC governance configuration
rows.aocFeature: change requests as human-required decisions; governed configuration (process-type registry, rate card, mapping) changes are detected and audited; rollback to a pinned tag or SHA is itself a gated, audited decision
evidence: change.submitted, change.approved, change.started and change.completed events
config.changed, registry.changed, ratecard.published and mapping.published events
rollback.* events (requested, verification started and verified, approved or rejected, executed or failed)
rows.correctionNote: Corrected per §13: AOC-SPEC-002 tied change management to the technical-documentation control. Change management is anchored to 6.3 and 8.1. Caution: 6.3 governs changes to the management system itself; control of changes to the software the agents build sits mainly under 8.1 (map-010). Confirm the split.

rows.aocControl: Operational planning and control: plan manifest, change control and gated promotion
rows.aocFeature: plan manifest declared at session start (tasks weighted, evidence per task, audited amendments); change requests; promotion refused unless provenance traces to an approved change, UAT sign-off and gate
evidence: plan.declared, plan.amended, task.done and phase.completed events
git.ref_pinned events (immutable tag per change and phase)
promotion.* events (requested, refused by the provenance gate, rejected at the go-live gate, failed or completed)
rows.correctionNote: Corrected per §13 (change management moved off the technical-documentation control). 8.1 covers control of planned changes and review of unintended ones; AOC change control and the provenance gate are the operational controls. Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Liveness and operation monitoring of agent sessions
rows.aocFeature: per-session sidecar heartbeats and transcript tail; derived states Working, Thinking, Stalled, Dead, Throttled (with reset time), Waiting on you, with fixed precedence; restart and nudge via the supervisor
evidence: throttle.hit and throttle.cleared events (resetAt, idle time)
rows.correctionNote: Per §13, A.6.2.6 is operation and monitoring. AOC-SPEC-002 had used it for event logging, which is now A.6.2.8 (map-001).

rows.aocControl: Measured progress, metering and recurrence trends
rows.aocFeature: progress = tasks done over tasks declared, evidence-backed; metering per actor, task, project and model; recurrence trend per root-cause class
evidence: task.done events with evidence (no-file-change closes flagged)
offence.transitioned events (recurrence over the verification window)
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. Main-clause anchor for monitoring. Confirm which AOC metrics are AIMS performance indicators.

rows.aocControl: Acceptance tests and requester UAT sign-off
rows.aocFeature: acceptance test is a mandatory change-request field; task_done evidence (test id, commit or diff); requester tests on UAT; rollback verification runs the target state's acceptance tests before anything touches main
evidence: task.done events with evidence kind test
rollback.verification_started and rollback.verified events (clean only when tests pass)
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. Confirm that verification of agent-built changes falls inside the AI-system life-cycle scope chosen for the AIMS.

rows.aocControl: Go-live gate with provenance guarantee
rows.aocFeature: promotion to main is a human-required decision under the Approver's name (passkey); refused unless every commit traces to an approved change record, a UAT sign-off and a gate; break-glass is the sole exception
evidence: promotion.* events (requested, refused by the provenance gate, rejected at the go-live gate, failed or completed)
passkey assertion recorded on go-live decisions
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Break-glass emergency promotion with mandatory post-incident record
rows.aocFeature: emergency promotion when production is down; routes straight to the Approver; auto-raises a post-incident change record due within 24 h; most heavily audited event
evidence: post-incident change record (the change record linked to the break-glass, counted under map-010)
rows.correctionNote: Corrected per §13: AOC-SPEC-002 mapped incident communication to A.8.3. A.8.3 is external reporting; communication of incidents is A.8.4. Communication to users and external parties beyond the Approver needs an organisational procedure.

rows.aocControl: Abstracted status for requesters
rows.aocFeature: intake portal shows only 'being worked on', 'ready for your testing' or 'completed'; never internal gate names, the approver's identity, queue depth or an implied timeline
rows.clauseTitle: System documentation and information for users
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. A.8.2 also expects documentation for users; the portal should state that AI agents work on tickets. Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Documented AI resources: process-type registry, models, rate card, subscription and FX
rows.aocFeature: fixed process-type registry (model fixed at launch); versioned rate card applied forward only; subscription cost recorded separately; daily USD/MYR rate stamped fetched-live or inherited
evidence: fx.rate_recorded events (fetched-live or inherited, source date)
rows.correctionNote: Corrected per §13: token and resource use belongs to A.4, not A.7. Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Tooling inventory per session
rows.aocFeature: supervisor records Claude Code version, tool list, MCP servers and permission mode from the session's init line; hooks record tool use and denials
evidence: session.launched events (Claude Code version, tools, MCP servers, permission mode)
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. Depends on the supervisor persisting init metadata. Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Metering of tokens, compute and plan-limit idle time
rows.aocFeature: sidecar transcript tail deduped by message.id; notional API-equivalent cost labelled as such; plan-limit hits and throttle idle time; credit caps enforced only at task boundaries (metering never gates)
evidence: credit.* events (allocations, cap hits, auto-grants, top-up requests and their grant, denial or withdrawal)
rows.correctionNote: Corrected per §13: AOC-SPEC-002 mapped token and resource use to A.7 (data). Resources are A.4; computing resources specifically A.4.5.

rows.aocControl: Controlled acquisition of intake media (PDPA surface)
rows.aocFeature: intake uploads: size and magic-byte type limits, malware scan, encrypted body store, hashes only in the chain; triage sessions read-only with no deploy credentials
evidence: intake.attachment_stored events (validation and scan result, content hash)
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. A.7 is framed around data used by AI systems; intake media are inputs to agent sessions, so applicability must be confirmed. PDPA duties (notice, consent, retention, access, erasure) are legal requirements outside Annex A.

rows.aocControl: Provenance and erasure of intake data
rows.aocFeature: every attachment hashed and linked to its ticket; per-scope encryption keys allow crypto-shredding while the chain stays valid
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. Confirm applicability (see map-020).

rows.aocControl: Anthropic (Claude Code CLI and Claude models) managed as a supplier
rows.aocFeature: supplier register entry; per-session model and Claude Code version captured at launch; plan-limit (throttle) records; integration facts re-verified after each Claude Code upgrade (docs/research/claude-code-integration.md)
evidence: session.launched events (model id, Claude Code version)
integration re-verification record after Claude Code upgrades
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. A.10.2 (allocating responsibilities between the organisation and Anthropic) may also apply. Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Human-required decisions, credential isolation and read-only triage
rows.aocFeature: decision cards for the main, production, irreversible, ambiguity and data tests; deploy credentials only in supervisor-controlled session environments; triage sessions read-only; PreToolUse guards turn attempts into decision cards
rows.clauseTitle: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Responsible-use objectives tracked as metrics
rows.aocFeature: provenance guarantee (no orphan commits to main), affirm-without-edit rate per developer, evidence-backed progress, cost-per-outcome as a portfolio lens only (never individual ranking)
rows.clauseTitle: Objectives for responsible use of AI system
evidence: task.done events flagged for no file change
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. The objectives themselves must be set by management (clause 6.2). Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Intended use declared at launch via the process-type registry
rows.aocFeature: aoc run --type picks from a fixed registry that sets model, tools and permissions per type; agents cannot name their own type
rows.clauseTitle: Intended use of the AI system
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Self-modification boundary for the governance, audit and credit core
rows.aocFeature: AOC agents may build product features but never the governance, audit or credit core; attempts are blocked; AOC self-changes are audited outside AOC
rows.clauseTitle: Processes for responsible AI system design and development
evidence: config.changed events (governed files detected by hash at startup)
external review record for AOC self-changes
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. Also relevant to A.9.2. Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Reporting of concerns without blame
rows.aocFeature: agents report repeatable error classes (report_error); FX and other discrepancies become human-reviewed decisions; error-learning data is clustered by root cause and never used for per-person ranking
evidence: policy record: root-cause classes only, no per-person blame data
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. Gap: AOC has no dedicated channel for a person (developer or requester) to raise a concern, and no rule for reporter confidentiality. Add a 'raise a concern' decision type or an organisational procedure. Confirm.

rows.aocControl: Corrective action through distilled lessons and repeat-offence tracking
rows.aocFeature: errors clustered by root cause; repeat-offence lifecycle detected, root-caused, fix applied, verified closed (no recurrence over a window); lessons bind only after a human decision, are scoped and retire when unused
evidence: offence.transitioned events (verified_closed after the recurrence window)
rows.correctionNote: No AOC-SPEC-002 row. 10.2 requires root-cause analysis and a review of effectiveness, which the verified_closed state provides. Confirm which error classes count as AIMS nonconformities.
